name: embryology histology pathway
title: Early embryogenesis in order: fertilization, zygote, cleavage, blastulation and implantation in week 1, the bilaminar disc in week 2, gastrulation in week 3, and neural tube closure and folding in week 4.

nodes.title: WEEK 1 - Fertilization in the ampulla
lines: acrosomal enzymes cross corona radiata and zona pellucida

nodes.title: Cleavage - division with NO growth
lines: MORULA, same size as the zygote

nodes.title: Blastulation, day 4
lines: EMBRYOBLAST inner mass to embryo proper

nodes.title: Implantation, day 5
lines: blastocyst hatches from the zona pellucida

nodes.title: WEEK 2 - the twos
lines: embryoblast splits into hypoblast and epiblast, the BILAMINAR DISC
trophoblast splits into cyto- and syncytiotrophoblast

nodes.title: WEEK 4 - neural tube closes, embryo folds
lines: HEART is the first organ to function
